[Story]
During the New Year, Li Hua visits friends and relatives everywhere. One day, Li Hua visits a friend's house. The friend is very enthusiastic and even gives cigarettes to Li Hua. Li Hua also politely accepts them. Then they chat with each other, make fun of people and things they encounter. As they talk, it is noon. Li Hua's friend says, "Guests are coming to my house at noon, why not sit together?"

[Question]
What does Li Hua's friend really mean when he says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Li Hua's friend wants to use the guests as an excuse to involve Li Hua in the lunch.
B. Li Hua's friend hopes Li Hua can stay for lunch
C. Li Hua's friend wants Li Hua to meet new friends
D. Li Hua's friend hints that Li Hua should leave
